asr.full_text: Music Last year I wasn't even planning to study for Neet PG. I wanted to give another year to my daughter and I wanted her to be around to and start preparing for my NEET-PG but one incident happened. the cantonment where I used to live in was attacked and they were lot of casualities and was the first doctor attending all the casualities. So after that incident life really took a u turn. Everything got very busy, there were so many patients and after that there were so many followups and everybody got acutely stressed and I was not able to come out of that and that was the first time I became so stressed about my job. I'd never seen such action before in my life. So gradually I thought may be if I start reading that, you know, reading will divert my mind and take away the stress. So, I had one or two subject wise books with me, and I tried to read from that. It was very difficult, I was not able to read from that. So, at that time, one of my juniors who joined me for some time because of the hectic work load, he joined me, and he told me about Mar about marrow that there is some app with which you can prepare for your knee PG I wasn't even aware of it I hadn't even heard the name For me Marrow was bone marrow so He told me to check out the app I I didn't. That was around March, 2018. After 4-5 days, he again told me, ma'am check out the app, it is really very good. I am preparing from it, it is awesome. I was like okay fine. I will check it out. He said download the free version, check out the app, and if you like it, buy it, otherwise don't buy it. I was like okay. ok fine I will try it but I still did not try it but he keep pestering me did you check it did you check it so after about 15-20 days I finally downloaded Marrow free version and in 2-3 days I saw the first lecture. it was a physiology lecture by krishnakumar sir and I was impressed hugely and I thought probably it is very difficult for me to study from this book now as it's been 7 years since I did my MBBS and with babies it was difficult So, I thought maybe I can try watch videos lying down while she is sleeping and that's how I could start Towards the end of March, I finally downloaded the paid version of Marrow and I started preparing maybe 1 or 2 lectures in a day and that was it. And within 10-15 days I had to take a break because I had to go on leave I had to, I had to go to Pune I was doing postgraduate diploma in hospital management and all so there was a convocation for that so I had to move in for that So, that was a month's break Finally when I came back in May and I started again That was the time I actually started preparing properly And I heard till Deepu sir's full session that you know Making notes is the most important thing. And I think that's one thing that stuck into my head that making notes is the most important thing. So that's the time I bought a few registers and whenever I used to read, I used to switch on the video and start making notes to whatever lectures I was attending to. I'll be honest, I have not seen all the videos and I have not studied all the subjects. I studied the first two years all the subjects, the seven subjects for the first two years and then I studied community medicine, I studied obstetrics and psychiatry, that's all. That's all I've studied. For some subjects I have seen JASTI videos. For some subjects I have just started on QBank. So it was a mixture because I did not have a lot of time. I had ten-month old when I started preparing. So and she was my priority she has always been my priority I used to study only when she is sleeping otherwise whatever time I have his hearts so in the afternoon if she was sleeping for 1 1 1 1 for I used to read and at 10 o'clock she generally goes off to bed at 5 o'clock so after 10 o'clock. So after 10 o'clock, I used to read till whenever I can stretch till 12, 1 or on some good days till 2. And because I cannot go out of the bed otherwise she would wake up. I used to read there on the bed where she's sleeping with the lights off. That's how I made use of the videos and the videos light I used to write , that is how I made use of the videos and the video slide I used to write that is how I have read but probably taking care of her she is blessed me and I could score what I did when I started preparing in May I realized I do not have a lot of time and I was actually freaked out when I saw few videos of the toppers, who have studies all the subjects, revised so many times and they are preparing from the second year of college and they have just finished an internship and then we'll be giving the exam or some people are doing their internship and giving the exam. I am much, much beyond that. Seven years back, I finished my MBBS and've been working as a Medial Officer since then. So, I thought, my goal was to clear the exam that is to get 50 percentile . That was my goal till the day I went to give the exam. I wanted to give the exam. I wanted to score 50th percentile to be eligible. Becuase being from the services, It is possible that I might get some subject if I have cleared the exam if I am eligible for the Counseling. So I might get something, I might get Hospital Management or I might get Anatomy, I was ready to take anything I was getting. So, and... Initially when I saw Krishnakumar Sir's video, I was willing to take Physiology. Because, you know, I thought, he is such a good teacher in Physiology, why can't I be like that. So that was my target initially. And that was my target till the end. The day I went to give the exam also, I just prayed to God that, please give me 50th percentile. Because I was not ready to do the entire thing all over again the next year. I just couldn't do it again. I told my family also and I'll not be able to do it now. Whatever happens it is this time only. I had never appeared for NEET-BJ before also. This was the only attempt that I had given. I stuck to everything Deepu Sir said in his lectures, make notes, read from the notes, revise from the notes, attempting maximum questions is better with a 4 to 4 negative marking ratio Somehow I also have the same ideolog and it was just like somebody's backing me up to do whatever I am thinking so I just went away with that So that's how I prepared and I am very proud of one thing, that I never took away any minute of my daughter's time to do whatever I've done, so that makes both of us happy. She's also happy that I'm around and I'm also happy that I could do it in one go. This is my bundle of joy. She's blessed me, she's blessed me with dermatology. Hi, I am Major Hrithita Pall, I appeared in NEET PG for 2019 and I had a rank of 5428 overall and in services my rank was 8. I have prepared using Marrow and Marrow alone. I have loved the entire exercise. My favourite faculty in Marrow is Aihala Mam. Pathology, she is a pathology goddess. I can actually go and touch her feet, the way she makes you write notes and write it down, put a star mark. Draw lots of star marks . I loved that. As I used to look through Pathology grades for my exams and study their grades, I used to remember how she wrote them down and helped me do everything. As well as some of the questions we were asked. It was amazing. In the services, my rank was 8th. That was a single digit rank and I was really really happy. Anybody who ranked before me. All the 7 people, they are not even married So, I am happy to achieve whatever I have achieved at my age and my personal life at this point of time actually as I kid also I had always wanted to go into army but somehow with my poor physical standards I couldn't have done it and then I came across my husband who is also an army officer he is not a doctor, he is an infantry officer and then I decided that I'll become a doctor in the Army. That's how things happened and I'm satisfied with the choices I have made. It was a good decision. Maybe my PG got delayed but there are a lot of things that I've seen that no other doctor in civil will ever see. One of the best things about Marrow was the grant tests. When I initially started using Marrow, I saw the lecture by Dr.Deepu who stressed on the importance of grantees. So I took the grantees that was there, when I started using it. And how he has emphasized that no matter how prepared you are, you need to give the exam every month. So though I was not making a lot of progress in completing my subjects and completing the lectures or the QBank. I always used to take the grant test whenever it went on. Most of the time I used to try and take it within the time so that the results come later and once or twice after the date got over. But I would make sure to take all the grand tests that were available. And there were some fluctuations in the rank. I never even used to qualify in the first months of my preparation. My percentile used to be 38 or 42 or ,if I have done something really great maybe 52. So that is how but still. I.. it was not that I will not give the grant test. If I us-d to talk to fellow people who were preparing they used to be like no I am not prepared enough I will not give the grant test. I used to be like no, I'm not prepared enough. I will not give the grand tests. I used to tell them you'll never be prepared enough even the day before exam. You will not be prepared enough. But it is important to practise to have that habit of giving your 100% for those three hours. Only practise can bring it. You can't read for a year and go back and vomit it out that day. No, it has to be practising That was so, so true. keep for a year and go back and vomit it out the day, no it has to be practice and that was so true. And I used to make notes and they kept reading till 10th october and then I thought it's high time i start revising. That's that how I remember. Very clearly during 11th october i started revising, When i opened the first note and first page I could not even read handwriting handwriting and I was actually lost but that time again one of the videos appeared Dr. Deetu again said this happens, this is normal with everybody. That is why revision is important and you have to revise. So I went through, completed my first revision and when I completed my first revision my percentile in the grant test it went beyond 50. So I became a little confident that I might be able to clear the exam and once the test for October and November were done I was scoring more than 60% Tile. So I thought if I am scoring more than 60% Tile here, I might be able to score more than 50% in the exam, which was my target. And then the marrow mock test happened in December. I remember it so clearly. Well, some people had taken it and there was a buzz all around. It is a tough test. I was a little scared to take it but I had taken all the tests, I wanted to take that also. I took the Merrot-Mock test. I was eagerly waiting for the results. I remember I could not study for two days waiting for the result to see how things are going to be. And I remember I got 84 percentile in that and my rank was 14000 and I was really happy with the result because the buzz going round was it is a very difficult test and my target was 50 percentile. I was getting 84% in that, so I thought I am on the Right Track! But one thing I had in mind was that many of the people at that time were like if your rank is more than 10,000 then there is no need to study this here. You should try harder next year and get a rank below 10 000 that was neither my target also nor nor i could afford to give away so much that i had gone through the six months that i'd put in i was not ready to do it again so i kept going i kept going till the last day and that is how my rank improved from the Marrow granted most of the people say whatever their grand test rank was that was the final rank. But my rank improved way beyond that and because I did not quit on the day of mock test and I kept going. I kept reading my notes and it showed that I could do two revisions though I would plan for the three while I didn't do anything else than do two revisions. And another thing one good thing that was there with me was that I did not study the day before the exam because everybody wants to study till the last minute I remember when I went to my Center there were you know people kids for me you know they were so so much younger than me they were reading you know they were reading sitting in the car they were reading standing outside the door in the centre and there notes on their hands and photocopies what and what not and I was roaming around hand in hand to motivate me to give the exam. I actually watched a movie day before the exam! And tried to calm myself down, whatever I have have in my mind I am able to make use of that. Instead of making silly mistakes and succumbing to the pressure at the end of it. So I think that was a very good thing that my family made me do, not to study the last year of the exam. So that's... that's how I prepared and gave the exam and it was a wonderful association I'll always be inducted tomorrow when I was preparing I was therefore my baby most of the time but when I went out to office because I was working also simultaneously my mother-in-law used to take care of my daughter. I also have a full time help with me. They took very good care of my daughter, but whenever I am home, it's me and only me for my daughter. Then she will not go to anybody else, but they have been great pillars of support for me. I also had one of my I can say sister and colleague who was preparing with me and we were preparing together. We used to discuss things mainly in the form of what you have studied and what do you plan to study and all and when to take the G.E.T. and share our ranks and all. I'd only one person to do it with because I thought not having anybody will make me feel lost but having too many will also be difficult to you know enterprate things. So I had one fellow person whom I was continously in touch with and she was also prepared with Marrow, she's also cleared it and she is taking up pathology at Delhi army hospital R&R, she is doing pathology at Delhi Army Hospital, R and R she is doing Pathology now there. Marrow is a very good option for people who are serving because wherever we are posted you do not have Poaching Institute where you can go and attend classes So having a, you know, privilege of getting things online was really awesome But another thing was that because of the poor net connectivity, it was not at my will that when I wanted to watch a particular video I could watch it no, it was not so so whenever I had time whenever the videos were not opening, I used to open the queue bank, because that could open up in lesser speed also that is why I could not opening i used to open the cue bank because that can open up in lesser speed also that thing that is why i could not watch videos for some of the subjects that i wanted to but i could not because of poor net connectivity but still it is a very very good option than not having anything at all with people who are living in cities metros metros, there they have very good connectivity I think Mahro is the best option they have you can you know, be in the comfort of your own bed, still be studying instead of going out in the heat and trying to reach places to get your classes on It's much more comfortable and you can modify it as per your requirement I want to study this subject today, I want study that topic today." which is not there there you have to stick to the timetable that they prepare for you it is not on your choice which might be doable for a few but I think is a restriction for most the day the result came I was so happy I actually shouted at the top of my voice scaring my daughter and both of us cried for some time and I was so happy that I shouted at the top of my voice scaring my daughter. Then both of us cried for sometime. And I was really happy and it was a collective effort for my entire family. And team Maru and I was so happy the next day. I wrote an email to team Maru because know I really feel so thankful to them because I was aiming for just 50th Person Thailand I could get a rank in 5,000 that I never even imagined I'll be able to do with the amount of subjects that I had read in the amount of content of Marrow that I had used but whatever it was it was wonderful I was not cramming things, I was actually making good concepts and I think, it helped me to become a better clinician. I can actually say that. See.. I'll tell you... if I can do it.. anybody can do it. and being a mother makes you stronger that I've realized gradually with time maybe I wouldn't have been you know so motivated to do it had I not been a mother she makes me stronger she makes me go and that helps you know I wanted to do it for my daughter you know when she grows up and people ask her what's your daughter? She should be proud enough to tell what her mother does. I really wanted to do it for her so being a mother is not at all wrong thing when you are preparing. It it makes you stronger physically, mentally of course. And if you can bring up a child you can definitely clear need V E G
